about: Mod ping-pong round 5, batch 5 (docs/design/mod-pingpong.md#lote-5--neo-vitae): Neo Vitae, the successor of Blood Magic, approved by Elias on 27 September for acts III-IV with its own dimension, and Sanguine Neural Networks from the outward search. Staging by the neovitae family of tools/generate_family_balance.py, which also removes the teleposer: it swaps blocks across claims and into Heliodor ruins without any protection event.

neovitae: Blood magic: the Ara Vitae altar and its tiers, blood orbs, sigils, runes, alchemy, rituals and the Demon Realm dungeons

The altar takes the propagation core (Act III, the whole mod, like Psi's assembler); the master ritual stone takes Twilight ironwood (Act IV), so rituals and the dungeon gateways to the Demon Realm open in the observatory act. The teleposer, its foci and the teleposition sigil are removed: teleposers swap blocks without asking FTB Chunks or the ruins
sanguine_networks: Blood for the Ara Vitae from Hostile Neural Networks data models, without a mob farm
The virtual sacrificer takes Twilight ironwood in its free corners (Act IV)
